description: Fetch aggregated WakaTime coding stats for a user over a range ("last_7_days", "last_30_days", "last_6_months", "last_year", "all_time"); returns totals and rankings by language, project, editor, and OS. Keyless for public profiles; pass your OAuth token as _apiKey for private ones.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: stats
title: Stats
